author: ShadowGuard
description: Built-in local rules for common supply-chain risk signals.

rules.name: Git source dependency
rules.message: Dependency is resolved from a Git repository instead of a package registry.
rules.recommendation: Prefer a pinned registry package or review the repository and commit reference before release.

rules.name: URL source dependency
rules.message: Dependency is resolved from a direct URL.
rules.recommendation: Use a trusted package registry or verify the downloaded artifact and its checksum.

rules.name: Local path dependency
rules.message: Dependency is resolved from a local path.
rules.recommendation: Confirm the local dependency is intentional and included in the release process.

rules.name: Pre-release version
rules.message: Dependency version appears to be a pre-release build.
rules.recommendation: Prefer a stable release version for production builds.
